title: Need CryptoLib for SPC563M64L5
content:
The SPC563M64L5 does not have an inbuilt SHE module. I need to perform cryptographic functions for one of my applications running on this controller.

Could anyone let me know if a cryptographic library is available for the SPC563M64L5? If so, where can I find it?

scraped_replies.html:
You may need to change to MCU with SHE module inside.

Do you want to change to SPC56 series MCU with HSM?

Data brief - SPC58-HSM-FW - SPC58 HSM Firmware

Thanks for your reply.

Unfortunately, this is not an option for us, as the MCU has already been finalized for production.

Is there any ST cryptographic software library available for this controller? The application I am working on needs to perform few cryptographic functions.
